name: Nodal Theme Switcher
author: xft0729
desc: Editor themes and canvas presets for Nodal.
longDesc: Adds 13 editor themes and 12 canvas presets. Pick a theme from the palette button in the toolbar. Settings stay in your browser.
features: 13 editor themes, from light and dark to high contrast
12 canvas presets with matching line colors
Import and export custom theme files as JSON
